method: Release frameworks supplied by caller. Metal required. Alternating process order. Each process discards three warmups and takes medians of 15 fresh documents. XML is in memory; bitmap allocation and clearing are outside timers. Total is parse plus first draw. Redraw uses each instance after its first draw. Initial per-process timings are recorded separately, not guaranteed cold startup. Summary reports medians of process medians.
experiment: Read stroke-linejoin keyword bytes directly into an enum for built-in path, use and group nodes without stylesheet rules or inline styles. Preserve the existing parser for other inputs and unrecognized values.
decision: Prototype reverted: approximately 9% parsing improvement in the 3000-keyword synthetic fixture, but no measured parsing improvement in Pcolormesh 2. Does not rule out benefits from broader byte-based numeric or reference parsing.
validation: Release build passed; first and warm rendered pixels identical in all paired runs. Experimental path was not retained.
